candidates.title: /slots publishes per-request token counts that reveal what a local tool-using agent did; options to limit it
candidates.snippet: **Summary.** We measured what llama-server's slot-status endpoint (`/slots`) reveals when the server backs a local tool-using agent (Home Assistant 2026.8.0's built-in llama.cpp integration, virtual devices only, mocked dispatch). The endpoint carries no user text, but its counters do carry action information: tool calls and the hub's tool results are structured text, so their token counts act as codes. A co-resident process that only polls `/slots` recovers the class of the device action above
